Thanks, this is a real miss in #3 and the table in the PR body is the right shape: an answered eth_call is an answer, and an empty 0x or a revert on the bound input is a refutation, not "could not be queried".

One case I would change before merging. In the diff, the tampered-output check still runs after the bound call has already failed. changes.author: giskard09
changes.title: verifier: an answered leg-1 eth_call is FAIL, not INCONCLUSIVE
changes.text:
Merged as 3bd79ca. From a clean clone of master: 23 tests pass, and the --no-network run still lands on 5 PASS, 3 INCONCLUSIVE.

I ran the one case I raised: bound call reverts and the tampered call reverts. The run exits 1 with a FAIL for the bound call, so the verdict is right; the extra "[PASS] tampered outputHash is rejected" line after it is what misleads. We will make the control conditional on the bound call returning true in a follow-up commit on master, with a test, and credit you for the report.

Thank you for the fix and the live check.

changes.author: giskard09
changes.title: verifier: an answered leg-1 eth_call is FAIL, not INCONCLUSIVE
changes.text: The follow-up is merged: #5, f98b285 on master. The tampered-outputHash control now counts only when the bound call returned true; otherwise it is reported INCONCLUSIVE ("negative control not informative"). Leg 1 also checks eth_chainId first, so an RPC on another network is INCONCLUSIVE and its empty answer is not read as "no contract". The commit carries "Reported-by: Echo-Merlini". From a clean clone of master: 27 tests pass.
